title: Essential Basic Health Check
description: A baseline diagnostic profile designed for young adults to track essential organ functions, blood counts, and metabolic baseline.
idealFor: Young adults aged 18 - 35 seeking an annual routine health checkup.
testsIncluded: Lipid Profile (Total Cholesterol, HDL, LDL, Triglycerides)
Kidney Function Screen (Serum Creatinine, Blood Urea)

title: Advanced Heart Health Check
description: Cardiovascular risk screening combining blood lipid biochemistry, non-invasive electrical tracing, and cardiologist consultation.
idealFor: Individuals with family history of heart disease, elevated BP, high stress, or age 35+.
testsIncluded: Complete Extended Lipid Profile with Ratios
preparation: 12 hours overnight fasting. Bring past cardiac records if available.

title: CareSphere Women's Wellness Package
description: Tailored hormonal, bone health, reproductive, and nutritional assessment designed specifically for women across all stages.
idealFor: Women of reproductive and menopausal age seeking comprehensive preventative screening.
testsIncluded: Complete Blood Count with Serum Ferritin & Iron (Anemia Profile)
preparation: 10 hours fasting. Full urinary bladder required for pelvic ultrasound.

title: CareSphere Senior Citizen Comprehensive Care
tagline: Holistic Preventive & Chronic Health Screening for Elders
description: Comprehensive panel addressing joint vitality, cardiac health, kidney filtration, bone density markers, and metabolic balance.
idealFor: Senior citizens aged 60+ for annual or semi-annual health monitoring.
testsIncluded: Kidney Function Test with eGFR & Serum Electrolytes
Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, Serum Calcium & Uric Acid
preparation: Overnight fasting for 10-12 hours. Morning medications may be delayed upon doctor's advice.

title: CareSphere Diabetes & Metabolic Care Package
description: Specialized assessment designed for individuals diagnosed with diabetes or prediabetes to prevent microvascular and kidney complications.
idealFor: Persons with pre-diabetes, diagnosed diabetes, or metabolic syndrome.
preparation: Fasting sample first, followed by breakfast with medication and post-prandial sample 2 hours later.

title: CareSphere Platinum Master Health Check
description: Our most exhaustive master checkup covering all vital organ systems, cardiac imaging, ultrasound sonography, cancer markers, and dual specialist consultations.
idealFor: Adults seeking an in-depth annual evaluation of all major physiological organ systems.
preparation: 12 hours overnight fasting. Wear comfortable two-piece clothing.
